title: Austin's Convention Center Cleanup & Art Museum Delay
summary:
*   Approved a $28,200 hazardous waste study for the Austin Convention Center property.
*   Delayed an agreement for the City of Austin Art Museum project, postponing its development.
*   Adopted resolutions to be submitted to the Texas Municipal League and National League of Cities annual conferences.

3:00 Ρ.Μ.
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooke called to order the
special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Councilmember Urdy.
CONVENTION CENTER The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember
Nofziger's second, approved a supplemental amendment to PSI for services required by the
City in connection with hazardous waste study being conducted by PSI on the Austin
Convention Center property at a cost not to exceed $28,200.00. (6-0 Vote, Councilmember
Urdy absent) TML The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Mayor Pro Tem
Shipman's second, adopted resolutions to be submitted to the delegates at the Texas
Municipal League 1989 Annual Conference.
(6-0 Vote, Councilmember Urdy absent)
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second,
adopted a resolution approving of a resolution to be submitted to the delegates of the
National League of Cities 1989 Annual Conference. (6-0 Vote, Councilmember Urdy absent)
ITEMS PULLED Pulled from the agenda was an amendment to project management services
contract with Gilbane Building Company.
Postponed was an agreement between the City of Austin and engineer/architect in connection
with the City of Austin Art Museum project.
The executive session was not held.
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 5:33 Ρ.Μ.
